Subject: Pilot kickoff proposal & access action items (recap)

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track decisions:

Key pain points you reiterated
- Latency and predictable throughput for batch clinical note generation during nightly windows (current infra spikes).
- Need for strict PHI controls and auditability for token-level access logs.
- Cost unpredictability with current vendor at scale; looking for predictable per-day cost for scheduled runs.

Success metrics we agreed to measure in the pilot
1) 95th percentile latency below 400ms for interactive queries (sequence length typical: 256–512).
2) Batch throughput: sustain 120k tokens/min with <3% error rate on nightly job.
3) Evidence of audit trail for all inference requests (KMS + audit logs) for SOC-ready review.
4) End-to-end cost projection for 30-day run at target throughput.

Scope we propose for the 30-day POC
- Model: open-model baseline (redwood-1b-quant) for initial run, fall back to redwood-owl for quality checks.
- Workloads: nightly batch job (primary) + subset of interactive queries from clinicians (30/day).
- Eval: prompt set of 120 representative clinical notes (you to provide 60, Aperture will pick 60).
- Owners: Aperture IT to provide network/VPN access; Aperture product to validate evals; Redwood PM (Jasmine) to manage day-to-day.

Access & setup asks (action items)
- Aperture: provide a staging service account and network allowlist (CIDR or IP list) — see attached network_access_matrix.xlsx. (Due: 2027-04-19)
- Aperture: share an initial sample of 60 prompt/eval cases (PHI redacted) for prompt tuning. (Due: 2027-04-20)
- Redwood: deploy sandbox environment, spike model profiles, and deliver a short runbook for audit logging. (Deliver by: 2027-04-22)
- Both: 30-min joint run to validate access and sample run once network allowlist is in place. (Target window: 2027-04-23 to 2027-04-25)

Attachments: pilot_scope_v1.pdf (scope + acceptance criteria), network_access_matrix.xlsx (network and account roles).

Proposed timeline (compressed):
- Week 0 (Apr 19–23): Access, account setup, and sample uploads
- Week 1 (Apr 24–30): Baseline runs, initial evals, and latency profiling
- Week 2–3 (May 1–14): Prompt tuning, batching configuration, quality checks
- Week 4 (May 15–21): Acceptance run + cost projection and handoff notes

If that looks right, reply with confirmation and the staging account details or call out anything we missed. Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the network matrix.

Best,
